text_block_list.text:
And the curtains close on the spring
Tenno Sho!
What a magnificent race!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик has never run so
magnificently!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
I mean, I was the one who won, but
still...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
What the—?! Where did all that strength
come
from?!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
You ran way more intensely than I did...
Such
strength!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Is it really you? Are you really the Super
Creek I
know?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
No, you're not my Супер Крик... But I've
seen
that look on your face before...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
So that's how you managed a race like
that...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Whew, that was an impressive race,
Super Creek.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: You really are my lifelong rival.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
But there are two Tenno Sho
races—spring and
autumn. Kyoto and
Tokyo. West and east. Cherry
blossoms
and autumn leaves.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I, Огури Кэп, shall be your opponent at
the
autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Er, did I mess up? Was that the wrong
vibe?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Nah, that was good. But don't get all
serious on
me outta the blue like that.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
And so Супер Крик managed to get a
great
result in her spring race against
Тамамо Кросс.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But why does she seem to have gotten
over all
that's happened?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
